title: Spy e-mails
summary: Who receives staff copies of ops mail. Kernel SMTP unchanged. Recipients are the rules list in this plugin config. Register channels with mail.spy.channels.

rows: Kernel seeds KERNEL_SPY_CHANNELS. Plugins append { id, pluginId, title, description, filters }.
This plugin fills { channelId, to }. Empty to skips the send.

blocks.title: Safety
blocks.text: Role user (customers) never receive spy mail. Recipients must be existing unlocked staff accounts. Matching many filters still sends one copy per email.

items.description: Plugins, Spy e-mails, Configure, Rules tab. That screen edits the rules list, including enabled, and writes config.json. There is no separate Spy e-mails menu.
tuucho-contact registers contact.inbound and contact.chat. Add those channel ids in rules to deliver them.
website_down / website_restore_failed use spyTo. If DB is down, warmOutageSpy reads $PRIVATE_DIR/warm-outage/spy-recipients.json. SMTP_HOST / EMAIL_NO_REPLY_FROM stay kernel SMTP JSON.

blocks.text: Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-mail-spy/ (public config.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

blocks.caption: config.json

items.description: string — public. Minimum delay between two spy mails of the same kind to the same person (for example 15m).
number — public. Day-of-month used when counting daily spy volume. Leave 30 unless you changed that cron convention.
boolean — public. Turn on only while testing locally. Leave off in production.
boolean — public. Stops every spy copy without disabling the plugin. Use for a quiet maintenance window.
text, public. JSON list of { channel, role } or { channel, email }. channel is a channel id or * for every channel. enabled false turns that channel off. Empty sends nothing.
string — public. Folder where spy mail is written in development instead of SMTP. Ignore on a live host.
